summary: Tested public API, unauthenticated auth gates, sign-in UI, invalid OAuth callback cleanup, and mobile sign-in layout. Public root and /auth/me behave correctly, but protected feature routes crash with 500 instead of returning 401, blocking authenticated dashboard and module testing.

critical.issue: Unauthenticated requests return 500 Internal Server Error instead of 401. Backend logs show AttributeError: 'Header' object has no attribute 'lower' in current_user because direct callers omit the FastAPI-resolved authorization argument and the Header(None) sentinel is treated as a string.

integration_issues.issue: Could not execute because protected backend endpoints crash before authentication can be established; no real OAuth test credentials are available.

action_items: Fix current_user so its authorization parameter is a real Optional[str] value when invoked directly (or pass the resolved authorization explicitly); all protected routes must return 401 without credentials.
Retest authenticated OAuth exchange, dashboard navigation, odontogram persistence, media upload, AI streaming, and logout after the auth helper fix.
critical_code_review_comments: The shared authentication dependency is unsafe when called directly: Header(None) is a Param sentinel, not a string. This causes an uncaught AttributeError across protected routes and is a security/error-handling blocker.

Several frontend API calls (dashboard/patients/AI/upload) do not expose request errors to users; once backend failures occur, the UI can remain blank or throw during stream handling instead of showing an actionable error state.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested unauthenticated flows (3/3); authenticated flows not executed

context_for_next_testing_agent: No credentials are present in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Public /api/ returns 200 and unauthenticated /api/auth/me returns 401. Invalid session_id callback clears the hash and returns to sign-in. Mobile sign-in at 390x844 has no horizontal overflow. Protected endpoints currently fail with 500 due to current_user Header sentinel bug.
rca of the issue: FastAPI injects Header(None) only when current_user is used as a dependency-resolved parameter. Feature handlers call current_user(request) directly, so authorization receives the Header object itself. The helper then calls authorization.lower(), raising AttributeError before its intended no-token 401 branch. Pass authorization from each handler or change the helper to read request.headers directly/guard for string values.
